verdict.rationale: Scheduled recurring jobs are a fair question for an AI code-review platform, for example scheduled codebase scans. However, the evidence shows only one-off or event-triggered actions: automatic reviews on new PRs, comment-triggered reviews, on-demand codebase scans, and a wiki kept current via a rolling PR. None of these is a documented capability for users to define recurring schedules for jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
